company.name: Sorce
company.shortDescription: Sorce offers a swipe-based job app where an AI agent completes applications for roles from entry level to executive.
company.description: Sorce provides a job search app that uses an AI agent to apply to roles on behalf of candidates. Users browse and swipe through listings, and the agent fills application forms and submits details supplied in the profile, reducing repetitive questions. The service spans roles across industries, from entry-level positions to senior roles, including technical and business functions. The platform includes referral links for onboarding and offers support via [email omitted]. Sorce focuses on simplifying the application process while keeping users in control of which jobs to pursue.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app that allows users to swipe right to apply or left to skip jobs, with an AI agent submitting applications on their behalf.
productsAndServices.name: Sorce Swipe-Based Job Application App

productsAndServices.description: A platform for companies to reach and hire candidates using tools for targeting, applicant flow management, and attribution.
